snapshot.scope: Independent Planning review of the signed PaddleOCR r3 catalog: exact release identity, platform locks, complete legal inventory, offline materialization and lifecycle boundaries.

reviewers.independence: Planning reviewed dependency, catalog, signing, legal and responsibility owners; Development independently produced the release builder, runtime, artifacts and lifecycle evidence.

dimensions.summary: Explicit install, verify, test, disable, enable and remove stay Main-owned; ordinary OCR never downloads dependencies.
Architecture, dependency registry, parser catalog, signing key, platform locks and legal roots bind the same r3 artifacts.
The release catalog is available without promoting the broader PaddleOCR requirement or exit status.
Exact artifact, signature, tree, wrapper, SBOM, wheel-lock and legal-integrity gates support reproducible release maintenance.
Existing architecture, dependency, parser, decision and inventory owners absorb the release facts without a new design document.

verification.command: npm run verify:parser-manifests && npm run verify:dependencies
verification.evidence: Both available r3 bundles bind exact Ed25519 signatures, platform locks, legal roots and zero-NOASSERTION inventories.

verification.command: npm run verify:docs && npm run verify:decisions
verification.evidence: Architecture, dependency, release-bundle and durable-decision owners agree on the signed offline catalog.

verification.command: npm run verify:boundaries && npm run verify:independent-documentation-review
verification.evidence: All six new service owners and directly changed LOC are inventoried; the reviewed snapshot binds the exact release contract.

coordination.compatibility: Native-first OCR routing remains; explicit PaddleOCR installation supplies the reviewed offline fallback without hidden package resolution.
coordination.acknowledgement: Planning binds exact r3 release and legal identities only; broader acceptance, background update, purge and platform evidence remain open.

nonBlockingRisks: The release remains explicit-download and prerelease-scoped; ordinary capture and OCR never install it implicitly.
Any artifact, signature, tree, wrapper, lock, legal-file or runtime identity drift fails closed before adoption.
Broader update, progress, cancellation, purge and packaged Windows acceptance remain outside this bind.
